summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the minutes of its Board of Directors meeting held on May 4, 2026. The Board approved routine items including the nomination of Michel Dimitrios Doukeris as chairman, compensation for the board and committees, and the composition of the Operations and Finance, Governance, and People Committees. In connection with a prior bylaw amendment on April 30, 2026, the Board removed three executive officers (Commercial Vice President, Beyond Beer Vice President, and an advertising professional) as part of a restructuring of executive positions and titles. This is a routine corporate governance update with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation event. The filing is equivalent to a current report for a foreign private issuer and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
